quotes.text: A story is not a line to be followed, but a garden to be wandered; the most profound truths are often found in the detours.
quotes.author: Eleanor Vance

quotes.text: Do not write to fill the page with ink, but to carve a space in the reader's soul where your words can echo long after the book is closed.
quotes.author: Julian Thorne

quotes.text: The blank page is not an enemy of silence, but a collaborator in waiting. Listen to what it suggests before you impose your will upon it.
quotes.author: Professor Alistair Finch

quotes.text: Every character you write carries a piece of your shadow and a spark of your light; storytelling is the alchemy of turning self-knowledge into universal truth.
quotes.author: Dr. Anya Petrova
